summary.en: Israel has expanded its military footprint in southern Lebanon, building a 90km network of roads and opening new bases, while Hezbollah continues artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Israeli strikes have wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65-year-old retired engineer, and French investigators are probing alleged Israeli war crimes in the area. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and protests against Israeli attacks have taken place in Sweden. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel har utvidet sitt militære fotavtrykk i sørlige Libanon, bygget et 90 km nettverk av veier og åpnet nye baser, mens Hizbollah fortsetter artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å betale kontantstøtte til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Israelske angrep har såret en libanesisk fotballspiller og ført til fengsling av en 65‑år gammel pensjonert ingeniør, og franske etterforskere undersøker påståtte israelske krigsforbrytelser i området. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon, og protester mot israelske angrep har funnet sted i Sverige. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
